gate_interpretation_clarifications: A defense that knows and compensates the corrupted observation channel is evidence about mitigation, not proof that no security problem exists.
An exact Bayesian comparator can share an observation-channel vulnerability. This limits attribution to learned-world-model error, not the existence of agent harm.
Prior statistics/control work limits first-concept novelty; a substantive native security contribution can still be evaluated without inventing an unrelated mechanism.

A materially better matched pretrained model/planner can address a previously unresolved transfer gate; repeating unchanged negative conditions cannot. Strong Clean, real utility, explicit permissions and generalization remain mandatory.

Lack of aggregate Clean ranking advantage over uniform does not negate a directly paired local decision harm. A replayed action-choice effect does not by itself prove complete mediation, a new live intervention, effective defense or generalization.
